method: Reviewed announced official 2026/2027 application rounds; canonical IDs and scoped applicant routes. No inferred annual dates or cutoff times.
integration_rules: Append unseen UUIDs; preserve all existing deadline and fee observations.
Install the exact Executive MBA programme and sourced university link before adding its dates or fees.
records follow the installed deadlines fields. record_evidence is a receipt sidecar, not an assumed database column.
Date-only due_at values must stay date-only in product copy; do not claim a midnight, local or UTC cutoff.
Application fee rows use period=total and category=application_fee; do not combine them with annual tuition or living costs.
Fees and dates are tied to the named route and cycle; do not expose these as university-wide application rules.
limitations: CUHK application guide and FAQ were available in the primary-page search index; direct fetch returned a gateway error. Two current official pages agree on both dates. Preserve this retrieval limitation.
HKUST, CUHK and Nazarbayev date-only rows do not publish exact cutoff times in the reviewed source.
ETH admission dates say 11:59 AM, while eApply labels the end as noon. The receipt uses the earlier explicit submission deadline; do not turn it into 11:59 PM.
Past 2026 UCA/WIUT rounds were excluded. WIUT announces December 2026 opening for 2027–2028 without an exact date, so no precise deadline was invented.
No unverified undergraduate mid-year NU deadline was added; direct access to that separate page failed.
No HKUST undergraduate application fee was inferred from postgraduate fee pages.
